variant_note: genuine bank fraud-ops callback about a blocked card

transcript.speaker: CALLER
transcript.utterance: Good afternoon, this is the fraud operations team at your bank calling on a recorded line.

transcript.speaker: CALLER
transcript.utterance: We flagged a card transaction of RM 3,200 this morning and want to confirm whether you made it.

transcript.speaker: CALLER
transcript.utterance: Thank you. We have already blocked the card. You do not need to do anything else today.

transcript.speaker: CALLER
transcript.utterance: We will never ask you to move your money, and we will never ask for a one-time code.

transcript.speaker: USER
transcript.utterance: Good, because I have been reading about scams.

transcript.speaker: CALLER
transcript.utterance: If you prefer, hang up and call the number on the back of your card, or our published line 013-3701 8113.

transcript.speaker: CALLER
transcript.utterance: A replacement card will reach you in three working days. Have a good afternoon.
